Version 3.14.1, 2026-11-06¶

  • Bump the reported version of FFI; this was missed in 3.14.0

  • Fix a build failure in 3.14.0 when deprecated features are disabled and legacy_ec_point is explicitly enabled. (GH #6100)

Version 3.14.0, 2026-11-04¶

General Notes¶

  • Botan4 is expected to be released in May 2027. This new major release will remove significant deprecated functionality. Please consult the deprecation notes in doc/deprecated.rst and if your usage would be impacted by any such deprecations, please comment in GH #4666

  • Add a warning to the documentation regarding recent research on the security of Classic McEliece. Following the current recommendations of BSI, Classic McEliece should only be used in a hybrid scheme. (GH #5993)

  • The API documentation now consistently warns about algorithms and operations with known side channel issues. (GH #6007)

New APIs and Features¶

  • Add types PK_Signature_Options PK_Encryption_Options, PK_KEM_Options, and PK_Key_Agreement_Options which allow an application to precisely control how public key operations (signature, encryption, decryption, KEM, etc) are performed. (GH #5489 #5864)

  • Add an implementation of HPKE from RFC 9180 (GH #5989)

  • Add an implementation of the BLS12-381 pairing friendly curve, including the groups G1, G2, and Gt and the pairing operation. (GH #5718)
